otherKnownLimits: Two original archives are packaged Unreal game demos. They are included intact; they do not contain directly reusable source meshes.
Legacy duplicate character versions remain intact in original archives and original loose folder; 138 canonical character models are prepared separately.
Six source monster files have no rig. Character_Female_01 lacks its matching supplied character PNG. See characters/catalog.json.
The older 132 skinned character sources have very short pose clips, not verified walk/run cycles. Police animation-source clips use a different skeleton and need import/retargeting verification.
CUTE3D DAE-derived GLBs are static geometry versions; original DAE and blend files are retained.
No automatically created NPC behavior, verified Roblox animations, mesh/audio/image IDs, or local-import bridge is claimed.
